regions.name: Niger River delta
regions.quote: E. s. togolensis has a relatively wide distribution extending eastwards from the Togo Hills in southeastern Ghana and southwestern Togo through southern Benin and southern Nigeria, including the Niger River delta, to the Cross River in southeastern Nigeria.

regions.name: Gabon Estuary
regions.quote: Type locality is 'Gaboon River', which presumably refers to one or more of the rivers entering what is now referred to as the Gabon Estuary in Gabon, western Africa.
